sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed 21-Nov at writing, not backdated; LK-only inputs, no market number enters the model; the tape was already in the file's history
sections.markdown:
Revenue FY2026E +7.2% is the 9M2026 LK actual (101,288.2 vs 94,475.9, S3 p.4) and equals 800 net adds on 21,120 banners (3.8%, F10/F9) plus CPI 3.28%. FY27/28E +7.0/6.7%.

**EBIT is LK income from operations, other operating income inside.** FY2025A 4,562.4 (audited LK p.17, F3). The dossier's 3,228.7 excludes other income 1,333.7 (LK p.17 / Note 21a p.118, F13): 4,562.4 − 1,333.7 = 3,228.7, a tie to the decimal. Note 21a: fee-based 764.2, space rental 251.2, admin services 130.1, royalties 55.0, product registration 45.5 (recurring, 1,246.0); insurance claims 42.5, asset-sale gains 17.0, other 28.1 (87.6, excluded). Recurring EBIT 4,474.8 = 3.53% margin, held flat.

9M2026 LK EBIT 3,191.7 (3.15%) vs 2,958.4 (3.13%), +7.9% (F17). FY2026E EBIT 4,795.9 implies Q4 1,604.3 on 34,574.1 = 4.64%, against Q4-2025 LK 1,604.0 on 32,261.3 = 4.97% (4,562.4 − 2,958.4): flat in rupiah, below last year's margin. Aldrich's ~3.9% is the same quarter on the dossier basis (1,251.2/32,261.3 = 3.88%, ex other income); Drew's 8.0% subtracted a dossier 9M from an LK full year. The 22.22% gross-margin bridge is not used.

Below EBIT: other −81 (FY2025A −177.1, 9M2026 −37.0), tax 18.85%, minority 6.1% (156.1/2,558.9), 41,091.8m shares (S3 p.6). DPS at 50% payout: the 1,705.3 paid in 2026 is 50% of FY2025 profit 3,410.9 (F31); the dossier's 41.5% is the FY2024 final paid in 2025.

DCF: WACC 11.3% (IDR band 11-13%), g 4.0%, capex 3.95% to 4.65% (FY2025A capex 4,994.7 = 3.94%), D&A 3.52% incl. ROU 2,492.1 (F14), NWC −1.78%; TV 46.6% of EV. Base 1,066. Sensitivity: margin ±50bp 856-1,277; WACC 11-13% 1,110-874; g 3-5% 1,001-1,152.

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: From memory, AMRT is the premium minimarket compounder whose 30x-era multiple came off, and the market reads that de-rating as structural: cooperative and challenger density against a thin-margin format.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** the de-rating is structural and margins are 2.5%, as the screen line shows.
**Why wrong:** the screen line omits 1,333.7 of fee, rent and royalty income the audited LK reports inside operating profit; LK margin is 3.6% and 9M2026 held it (3.15% vs 3.13%) on 7.2% growth. The edge is slow incorporation of LK footnote detail. It is priced at the tape (below).
**What proves us wrong:** price below 653, FY2026 other operating income below 1,100, LK margin below 3.0%, or net adds below 600.

**Price check (Phase 2).** Tape Rp1,085 (`the price snapshot`, 20-Nov, flat on 19-Nov): 12.4x FY2026E, 10.8x FY2028E, 8.24x FY2028E EV/EBIT against 8.10x at my base, 4.0% yield. The tape is 1.8% above base: no edge today, so this is a watch, not a buy. Entry 878 is derived, not read from a chart: (1,066 + 140.5 DPS FY26-28E) / 1.1118^3, the price at which reaching base pays the COE. It sits inside the pack's 52-week range (855-2,000, S25), 19% below the tape. At 878: up +21.4%, kill 653 −25.6%, EV −1.4%, up/|down| 1.37 vs library 1.67, own-Kelly −14.4% vs library +13.3%. Priced at one ARB band below the kill (fill ~490, −44%) EV is −12.6%. Which defect: (c), no trade at printed prices; target is the base DCF and the kill is a falsification value, not a stop. Own-Kelly turns positive, gap-priced, only below ~770, under the 52-week low: that is the sizing trigger.

sections.heading: Market microstructure & liquidity
sections.markdown:
**Liquidity.** `the liquidity feed` (21-Nov 10:00) now carries AMRT.JK at Rp83.6bn/day; 5% of INDO NAV (Rp0.76bn) is under 0.05 day at 20% participation. Sizing remains script/PM.
**Ownership.** Free float 40.81% (IDX-IC mirror, carried from T-INDO-AMRT-001, not re-verified), Sigmantara 50.19% (F21), treasury 0.69% (S3 p.6). No pledge or rights-issue signal.
**ARB.** ±25% band; a kill exit can fill one band below the trigger.
**Flows stale** (`fund record` empty); none estimated. Regime balance_of_payments_pressure / CAUTIOUS (asof 2026-11-21); "INDO rate-sensitive (banks NIM, property, consumer discretionary): AVOID". AMRT is net-cash staples, so the tilt sits in the 11.18% COE, not in demand.

sections.heading: House coverage reconciliation
sections.markdown: House v6 (12-Nov): BUY, target Rp1,189. House FY2026E EBIT 4,904.6 and EPS 88.90 sit 2.3% above mine (4,795.9; 87.43) because I strip 87.6 of non-recurring other income and drop the 22.22% gross-margin bridge. My 1,066 is DCF-only, 10% under the house target, which blends peer P/E 9.09x and a house DCF near 1,138. Bear differs: mine 653 is a thesis falsifier, the house bear v0 is 531.

sections.heading: New evidence
sections.markdown: new evidence: audited FY2025 LK p.17 and Note 21a p.118 (S4; house facts F3, F13) and 9M2026 LK p.4 (S3; F17). They tie dossier 3,228.7 to LK 4,562.4 and show recurrence in FY2024 (1,223.6) and FY2025 (1,333.7). This lifts the target from 660 (T-INDO-AMRT-001 overlay) to 1,066. Aldrich to rule.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. Q3-2026 dossier operating income 153.3 on 33,332.5 (0.46%) after 881.3 in Q2 and 1,103.9 in Q1 (ex other income): unexplained; FY2026E needs a 4.64% LK Q4.
2. Dossier EBIT FY2023-25 3,197.2 to 3,228.7 (+1.0%) on revenue +18.5%; ROE 23.5% to 18.9%. No operating leverage on the dossier basis.
3. Other income is 29% of LK EBIT and fee-based income (764.2) depends on suppliers; recurrence evidence is two audited years plus a derived 9M (981 to 1,053, LK less dossier, cross-source).
4. Minority share 6.1% (9M2026) vs 4.2% FY2025 as MIDI (77.09%) and LWS outgrow the banner.
5. Tape 1,085 already sits above base 1,066.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is 2029 and the position lost 30-45%. Suppliers or regulators cut the fee-based income, so the margin fell to 2.55% and the price broke 653, with an ARB-locked exit filling near 490. Second, a demand recession and permit cap took the house tail (298). Third, the limit never filled while the tape ran above base, so the thesis earned nothing.

sections.heading: Earnings quality gate
sections.markdown: Accruals (NI − CFO)/average assets FY2025 −10.5% (CFO = FCF + capex, dossier): clean. No special-notation or pemantauan khusus in the dossier. Q1-Q3 unaudited. PSAK 73: ROU depreciation 2,492.1; EBITDA excludes rent, so I value on EBIT/FCFF with ROU capex. Related-party receivables 12.9 (0.4%, F36); MIDI and LWS consolidate. Pledge and auditor not in the dossier.
